lines.l: Round and round and round and round
Round and round and round and round and round we feasted
Second guessing all the things that we've already done
Like the quarters in the trees and the space you're leaving in
Round and round and round and round
We spin round and round and round and round and round.
I'm sorry when this isle of funds came in
Oh, it's been round and round and round and round, it's been.
